title: gnaphalium glumaceum
intro: Gnaphalium glumaceum, commonly known as White Cudweed, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Gnaphalium glumaceum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
